course.title: Complex Variable, Vector Analysis and Statistics
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: Out of every 500 jobs at a computing center, 60 are of class 1, 30 are of class 2, and 10 are of (08) [CO3] class 3. A sample of 30 jobs is taken with replacement.
i) Find the probability that the sample will contain 10 jobs of each class.
ii) Find the probability that the sample will contain exactly 20 jobs of class 1.
iii) Find the probability that the sample will contain at most 2 jobs of class 3.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2023
